title: A Songbook for the Bakery
author: R. M. Coldharbour
blurb: Rafael Okafor, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
